त्: त The first consonant of the fourth or dental class, corresponding to the letter T, in tongue.
त: त m. (-तः) 	 1. A thief. 	 2. Nectar, the food of the immortals. 	 3. An out-caste, a barbarian or Mlechchha. 	 4. The flank, the hip or haunch. 5. A tail. 	 6. The womb. 	 7. A wicked man. 	 8. A tree. 	 9. A jewel. 10. A Buddha. 	 n. (-तं) 	 1. Passing, crossing. 	 2. Virtue, sancity. E. तृ to cross, &c. affix ड.
तक: तक r. 1st cl. (तकति) 	 1. To laugh at or deride. 	 2. To bear. With वि and अति prefixed, and implying reciprocity (व्यतितकते) To retort a laugh. (इ) तकि r. 1st cl. (तङ्कति) To live in distress to be in poverty or pain. (तंकते) To go to move. हसने सहने वा ड । हासे अक-सहने सक-भ्वा-पर-सेट् ।
तक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) That.  E. तत् that कन् pleonasm added.
तकिल: तकिल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Fraudulent, crafty, a rogue or cheat. 	 f. (-ला) A medicament, a drug तक् to deride, affix इलच्.
तक्य: तक्य mfn. (-क्यः-क्या-क्यं) 	 1. Laughable, ridiculous. 	 2. To be borne or en-dured.  E. तक् to laugh, यत् participial aff.
तक्र: तक्र n. (-क्रं) 	 n. Buttermilk with a fourth part water.  E. तक् to bear (sickness), Unadi affix रक्.
तक्रकूर्चिका: तक्रकूर्च्चिका f. (-का) Inspissated buttermilk.  E. तक्र, and कूर्च्चिक । inspissat-ed milk.
तक्रकूर्च्चिका: तक्रकूर्च्चिका f. (-का) Inspissated buttermilk.  E. तक्र, and कूर्च्चिक । inspissat-ed milk.
तक्रमांस: तक्रमांस n. (-सं) Meat fried with ghee, turmeric and asafœtida, &c. eaten with buttermilk.  E. तक्र, and मांस flesh.
तक्राट: तक्राट m. (-टः) A churning stick.  E. तक्र buttermilk, and अट what goes or is, (from it)
तक्ष: तक्ष r. 1st cl. (तक्षति) 	 1. To cover. 	 2. To skin or peel. (ऊ) तक्षू of 1st cl. (तक्ष्णोति) To pare, to plane, to make thin, to cut off to chip or slice; used in any other sense, this root takes the regular form only, whether simple or compound, as with सम् prefixed, To censure, (सन्तक्षति,) &c. भ्वा-पक्षे स्वादि-पर-सक-सेट् (चाचा छोला) ।
तक्षक: तक्षक m. (-कः) 	 1. A carpenter. 	 2. The Sutradhara, the manager and chief actor in the prelude of a drama. 	 3. One of the principal Nagas or serpents of Patala. 	 4. The divine artist, VISWAKARMA. 5. The name of a tree.  E. तक्ष् to chip, to peel or plane, &c. affix ण्वुल्.
तक्षण: तक्षण n. (-णं) Paring, peeling, planing, &c. 	 f. (-णी) A carpenter's adze. E. तक्ष् to plane or pare, affixes भावे ल्युट् and ङीष्.
तक्षशिला: तक्षशिला f. (-ला) The name of a city, the Taxila of Ptolemy in the Punjab.  E. तक्ष paring, शिला stone, built of hewn stones.
तक्षन्: तक्षन् m. (-क्षा) A carpenter.  E. तक्ष् to pare, Unadi affix कनिन्.
तग: तग (इ) तगि r. 1st cl. (तङ्गति) 	 1. To go or move. 	 2. To quake, to shake or tremble. 	 3. To trip, to stumble. भ्वा-पर-सक-सेट् इदित् । स्खलने कम्पेच अक०
तगर: तगर m. (-रः) 	 1. A shrub, (Tabernæmontana coronaria.) 	 2. A thorny shrub, (Vangueria spinosa.) 	 3. Another plant, commonly Tagara-mula. गॄ अच् । तस्य क्रोडस्य गरः ।
तगरपादिका: तगरपादिका f. (-का) A plant; also Tagaramula.
तङ्क: तङ्क m. (-ङ्कः) 	 1. An axe, a crow, a stone cutter's chisel: see टङ्क. 	 2. Grief upon separation from a beloved object. 	 3. Fear, terror. 	 4. Wearing cloth. 	 5. Living in distress.  E. तकि to be in distress, &c. affix अच्. भावे
तज्ज: तज्ज mfn. (-ज्जः-ज्जा-ज्जं) Immediate, instantaneous.  E. तत् that, (that moment,) and ज born. ततो जायते जन ड ।
तञ्च: तञ्च (उ) तञ्चु r. 1st cl. (तञ्चति) To go, (ऊ) तञ्चू r. 7th cl. (तनक्ति) To shrink or contract; also तञ्ज.
तञ्ज: तञ्ज (ऊ) तञ्जू r. 7th cl. (तनक्ति) To shrink or contract.
तट: तट r. 1st cl. (तटति) To be elevated or high, to rise. r. 10th cl. (ताटयतिते) To beat.
तट mfn. sub. (-टः-टा-टी-टं) A shore or bank. 	 n. (-टं) A field.  E. तट to to rise or be high, affix अच्, fem. aff. ङीप्.
तटस्थ: तटस्थ mfn. (-स्थः-स्था-स्थं) 	 1. Indifferent, alien, neuter. 	 2. Situated on the bank or shore. 	 m. (-स्थः) An indifferent person, one neither a friend nor a foe. 	 n. (-स्थं) That property which is distinct from the nature of any thing, yet is the faculty by which it is known: in other words, spiritual essence unconnected with bodily wants or passions.  E. तट a bank, a weight, and स्थ who stands. तटे ममीपे तिष्ठति स्था-क ।
तटाक: तटाक m. (-कः) A pond deep enough for the lotus and other aquatic flowers.  E. तट a band, and अक् to go, affix अच्; or तट-आकन् also तडाक; also ताटाक and तटीक.
तटिनी: तटिनी f. (-नी) A river.  E. तट a bank, and इनि poss. aff.
तड: तड r. 10th cl. (ताडयतिते) 	 1. To beat, to strike. 	 2. To shine: (इ) तडि. r. 1st cl. (तण्डते) To strike or beat. चु० उभ० सेट । दीप्तौ अक० आहतौ सक० आहतौ भ्वा० आ० सक० सेट् इदित् ।
तडग: तडग m. (-गः) A pond, a tank: see तडाग.
तडाक: तडाक m. (-कः) A pond or pool, one deep enough for the lotus. 	 f. (-क्रा) 	 1. A bank, a shore. 	 2. A blow.  E. तड् to beat, Unadi affix आक; also तटाक and तडाग.
तडाग: तडाग m. (-गः) 	 1. A pond, a pool, deep enough for the growth of the lotus, &c. See the preceding. 	 2. A trap for catching deer. E. तड् to beat, affix आग, deriv. irr.
तडाघात: तडाघात m. (-तः) A blow from an elephant's uplifted trunk.  E. तडा a beating, and आघात a blow.
तडित्: तडित् f. (-डित्) Lightning.  E. तड् to strike or beat, Unadi affix इति striking the earth, &c.
तडित्वत्: तडित्वत् mfn. (-त्वान्-त्वती-त्वत्) Lightning, emitting lightning, flashing. m. (-त्वान्) A cloud.  E. तडित् lightning, and मतुप् aff.
तडिल्लता: तडिल्लता f. (-ता) Forked lightning.  E. तडित्, and लता a creeper.
तण्डक: तण्डक mn. (-कः-कं) Complete performance or preparation. 	 m. (-कः) 1. A wag-tail. 	 2. Froth, foam. 	 3. The trunk of a tree. 	 4. The up-right post of a house. 	 5. A compound word. 	 6. A juggler. a cheat.  E. तडि to beat or kill, affix ण्वुल्.
तण्डु: तण्डु m. (-ण्डुः) One of SIVA'S doorkeepers, and one of the original teachers of the arts of dancing and mimicry.
तण्डुरीण: तण्डुरीण m. (-णः) 	 1. A worm, an insect. 	 2. A fool, a blockhead. 	 3. The water in which rice has been soaked or steeped.  E. तण्डुल rice, &c. ख affix, and ल changed to र. or तण्डा अस्त्यर्थे उरच् तढ भवः खः ।
तण्डुल: तण्डुल m. (-लः) 	 1. Grain after threshing and winnowing, especially rice. 2. A vermifuge plant: see विडङ्ग. 	 3. A potherb, a sort of Ama-ranth, (A. polygonoides.)  E. तड् to beat, Unadi affix उलच्, and नुम् inserted.
तण्डुजाम्बु: तण्डुजाम्बु f. (-म्बुः) Rice water or gruel.  E. तण्डुल, and अम्बु water.
तण्डुलीक: तण्डुलीक m. (-कः) A sort of Amaranth.  E. ईकन् added to the preceding; also तण्डुलीय.
तण्डुलीय: तण्डुलीय m. (-यः) 	 1. A kind of Amaranth. (A. polygonoides.) 	 2. Bidanga a vermifuge. 	 3. A mineral, iron pyrites.  E. तण्डुल grain, (to which the seeds, &c. are compared. and छ affix; also तण्डुलीयक.
तण्डुलु: तण्डुलु f. (-लुः) A plant of which the seeds are used as a vermifuge: see विडङ्ग.  E. तडि to beat, affix उलु.
तण्डुलेर: तण्डुलेर m. (-रः) A sort of Amaranth: see तण्डुलीय, &c.  E. तण्डुल, and एरक् aff.
तण्डुलोदक: तण्डुलोदक n. (-कं) Water in which rice has been boiled, rice gruel. E. तण्डुल, and उदक water.
तण्डुलौघ: तण्डुलौघ m. (-घः) A prickly sort of bamboo, (Bambusa spinosa.) 	 2. A heap of grain.  E. तण्डुल grain &c. or (as derived from तडि to bent, to tear,) a thorn, ओघ a heap or quantity.
तत्: तत् ind. Therefore, thence, the consequent or correlative to यत्.  E. तन् to spread, or extend, affix क्विप्.
ततःप्रभृति: ततःप्रभृति ind. Thenceforth.  E. ततस्, and प्रभृति the rest.
तत: तत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Spread, diffused, expanded. 	 2. Stretched, extend-ed. 	 m. (-तः) Air, wind. 	 n. (-तं) Any stringed instrument.  E. तन् to spread, &c. क्त affix, or Unadi aff. तन्.
ततचिह्न: ततचिह्न mfn. (-ह्नः-ह्ना-ह्नं) Distinctly marked.  E. तत, and चिह्न a mark.
ततपत्री: ततपत्री f. (-त्री) The plantain tree.  E. तत spread, and पत्री leaf, broad-leaved.
ततम: ततम mfn. (-मः-मा-मं) That one, (of many.)  E. तद् that, and डतमच् affix of the superlative degree.
ततर: ततर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) That one, (of two.)  E. तद् that, and डतरच् affix of the comparative degree.
ततस्: ततस् ind. 	 1. Therefore, thence, consequently. 	 2. From that, then. 3. Then, how, (asking.) 	 4. Then, further, after that (continuation.) 5. Afterwards, subsequently. 	 6. Thither, there.  E. तद् that, affix तसि.
ततस्ततस्: ततस्ततस् ind. 	 1. Hither and thither. 	 2. Then after that, what next; (asking impatiently.)  E. ततस् reiterated.
ततस्त्य: ततस्त्य mfn. (-स्त्यः-स्त्या-स्त्यं) Of or relating to that, &c.  E. ततस् as above, त्यप् aff.
तति: तति mfn. plu. (ततयः ततयः ततीनि) So many.
तति f. (-तिः) 	 1. A line, a row or range. 	 2. A number, a crowd.  E. तन् to spread, affix क्तिन्.
तत्कर: तत्कर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Obeying, serving, a servant.  E. तत्, and कर who does.
तत्काल: तत्काल m. (-लः) Present time, time being, or the time when an act occurs.  E. तत् that, काल time.
तत्कालधी: तत्कालधी m. (-धीः) A man wise or intelligent for the time being, one having presence of mind, &c.  E. तत्काल time being, and धी under standing.
तत्क्रिय: तत्क्रिय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Working without hire or wages.  E. तत् thence, क्रिया business.
तत्क्षण: तत्क्षण n. (-णं) Time present, time being.  E. तद् that, and क्षण moment.
तत्त्व: तत्त्व n. (-त्त्वं) 	 1. Essential nature, the real nature of the human soul, considered as one and the same with the divine spirit animating the universe: the philosophical etymology of this word best explains its meaning, तद् that, that divine being, and त्व thou, that very God art thou. 	 2. The Supreme being, or BRAMHA. 3. Truth, reality, substance, opposed to what is illusory or fallacious. 	 4. An element or elementary property, differently enumerated in different system from the three which are the same with the three Gunas, to twenty-seven, which in-clude the elements, organs, faculties, matter, spirit, life, and God. 5. A first principle, an axiom. 	 6. Mind, intellect. 	 7. Slow time in music. 	 8. A musical instrument. E. As above, or तद् that, then &c. affix त्व; the word is properly, therefore, written तत्त्व, but in books one त is commonly rejected.
तत्त्वज्ञान: तत्त्वज्ञान n. (-नं) Knowledge of divine truth.  E. तत्त्व as above, and ज्ञान knowledge.
तत्त्वतस्: तत्त्वतस् ind. Truly, accurately, fully.  E. तत्त्व, and तसिल् aff.
तत्त्वन्यास: तत्त्वन्यास m. (-सः) Touching different parts of the body in the worship of VISHNU.  E. तत्त्व, and न्यास gesticulation.
तत्त्वविद्: तत्त्वविद् mfn. (-वित्) Knowing the truth, knowing things as they are. E. तत्त्व, and विद् who knows.
तत्त्वावबोध: तत्त्वावबोध m. (-धः) Knowledge of spirit.  E. तत्त्व, and अवबोध ascertain-ment.
तत्त्वाभियोग: तत्त्वाभियोग m. (-गः) A positive charge or declaration.  E. तत्त्व, and अमि-योग accusation.
तत्पर: तत्पर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) 	 1. Diligent, attending to any thing closely and an-xiously. 	 2. Belonging to a principal object or intent of. 	 m. (-रः) The thirtieth part of the time of the twinkling of the eye.  E. तत् that, पर addicted to.
तत्परायण: तत्परायण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Attached or addicted to some particular thing or person.  E. तद् that, परायण attached to.
तत्पूर्व: तत्पूर्व mfn. (-र्वः-र्वा-र्वं) Prior, former.  E. तत्, and पूर्व before.
तत्पुरुष: तत्पुरुष m. (-षः) 	 1. That or a certain person. 	 2. A form of composition, (in Grammar,) usually consisting of two nouns, the first of which was in any case except the nominative or vocative; sometimes the inflection of the case is retained.  E. तत् that, and पुरुष man or person.
तत्फल: तत्फल mfn. (-लः-ली-लं) Resulting from any particular act, &c. 	 m. (-लः) 1. The white water lily. 	 2. A fragrant grass.  E. तद्, and फल fruit.
तत्र: तत्र (इ) तत्रि r. 10th cl. (तन्त्रयते) 	 1. To spread, to extend or expand. 2. To nourish or support a family, &c. चु० आ० सक० सेट् इदित् ।
तत्र ind. There, therein, the relative to अत्र.  E. तद् that, त्रल् affix, in lieu of the proper seventh case.
तत्रत्य: तत्रत्य mfn. (-त्यः-त्या-त्यं) Produced there or in a certain place.  E. तत्र, and त्यप् aff.
तत्रभवत्: तत्रभवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Venerable, respectable, reverend.  E. तत्र therein. (in all things) भवत् pre-eminent: see अत्रभवत्.
तथा: तथा ind. 	 1. So, like, correlative to यथा as, &c. 	 2. Thus, (implying certain-ty.) 	 3. So, so be it, (implying assent or promise.) 	 4. Thus, then, therefore, (or reply.) 	 5. And, so, in (conjunction.)  E. तद् in that, थाल् affix, implying manner.
तथागत: तथागत m. (-तः) A Jina or Buddha.  E. तथा thus, (what really is,) and गत known, obtained.
तथाच: तथाच ind. And so, thus, even so likewise.  E. तथा with च and.
तथात्व: तथात्व n. (-त्वं) Being so; the case or circumstance being admitted to be as stated.  E. तथा, and त्व aff.
तथापि: तथापि ind. Nevertheless, yet, even.  E. तथा, and अपि even.
तथाविध: तथाविध mfn. (-धः-धा-धं) Of such a sort or kind.  E. तथा and विध sort.
तथाराज: तथाराज m. (-जः) A Jina or Buddha.
तथैव: तथैव ind. So, even so, in the same manner.  E. तथा, and एव thus.
तथ्य: तथ्य mfn. (-थ्यः-थ्या-थ्यं) True. 	 n. (-थ्यं) Truth.  E. तथा thus, (what is really so,) and यत् aff.
तद्: तद् Relative or third personal pronoun. (सः सा तद्) He, she, it, that man, that woman, that thing.  E. तन् to extend or spread, Unadi affix अदि. डिच्च.
तद् (इ) तदि r. 1st cl. (तन्दते) To be content or happy.
तदतिपात: तदतिपात mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Transgressing, going beyond the bounds.
तदनन्तर: तदनन्तर n. adv. (-रं) Next, afterwards.  E. तत् that, अनन्तर after.
तदन्त: तदन्त n. adv. (-न्तं) To that end, just so far.  E. तद्, and अन्त end.
तदर्थ: तदर्थ mfn. (-र्थः-र्था-र्थं) 	 1. On that account, with that object. 	 2. Hav-ing such a meaning.  E. तद्, and अर्थ sense.
तदर्पण: तदर्पण n. (-णं) 	 1. A thing returned. 	 2. Delivering any article.  E. तद्, and अर्पण delivery.
तदा: तदा ind. Then, at that time.  E. तद् that, दाच् affix, implying time.
तदात्व: तदात्व n. (-त्वं) Time being, time present.  E. तदा then, त्व affix of the abstract.
तदानीम्: तदानीम् ind. Then, at that time.  E. तद् that, दानीम् aff.
तदाप्रभृति: तदाप्रभृति ind. Thenceforward.  E. तदा, and प्रभृति the rest.
तदामुख: तदामुख n. (-खं) Commencement, beginning.  E. तदा, and मुख beginning.
तदीय: तदीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) That, that person, that thing.  E. तद्, and छ aff.
तद्दिनम्: तद्दिनम् ind. 	 1. In the course of the day. 	 2. Day by day. 	 n. (-नं) On a certain day.  E. तद् that, and दिन a day.
तद्धन: तद्धन mfn. (-नः-ना-न) Miserly, niggardly.  E. तत् thence, धन wealth.
तद्वत्: तद्वत् ind. So, in like manner, the correlative to यद्वत् as.  E. तद् that, वति aff.
तद्वला: तद्वला f. (-ला) A sort of arrow.  E. तत् thence, वल strong.
तद्विध: तद्विध mfn. (-धः-धा-धं) In that manner, in such a manner, of such a kind or sort.  E. तद्, and विध way.
तद्धित: तद्धित m. (-तः) A derivative noun, as a patronymic or attributive of vari-ous kinds, &c. 	 n. (-तं) The formation of such nouns.  E. तत् that, (original noun,) हित what relates to or suits.
तन: तन (उ) तनु r. 8th cl. (तनोति-तनुते) To expand, to spread, to extend, to diffuse, to dilate, &c. physically or morally. r. 1st and 10th cls. (तनति तानयतिते) 	 1. To confide, to believe or have faith in. 	 2. To aid, to assist. 	 3. To be harmless. 	 4. To sound. 	 5. To pain or afflict with disease. 	 6. तपोनिष्ठ: तपोनिष्ठ mfn. (-ष्ठः-ष्ठा-ष्ठं) Performing penance, practising austerities. E. तपस् and निष्ठ engaged in.
तपोमय: तपोमय mfn. (-यः-यी-यं) Devout, practising austerities.  E. तपस् and मयट् aff.
तपोमूर्ति: तपोमूर्त्ति m. (-र्त्तिः) An ascetic.  E. तपस् and मूर्त्ति form.
तपोमूर्त्ति: तपोमूर्त्ति m. (-र्त्तिः) An ascetic.  E. तपस् and मूर्त्ति form.
तपोराशि: तपोराशि m. (-शिः) An ascetic.  E. तपस् and राशि a heap.
तपोवट: तपोवट m. (-टः) A country, part of central India or holy land.  E. तपस् religious austerity, and वट what surrounds.
तपोवन: तपोवन n. (-नं) A sacred grove, a place frequented by asceties.  E. तपस्, and वन a wood.
तप्त: तप्त mfn. (-प्तः-प्ता-प्तं) 	 1. Heated, Inflamed, burnt. 	 2. Scorched by pain or sorrow, distressed, afflicted. 	 3. Inflamed with anger, incensed 4. Undergone or performed as penance. 	 5. Fused, melted. 	 6. Burnish-ed.  E. तप् to heat, क्त aff.
तप्तकुम्भ: तप्तकुम्भ m. (-म्भः) A hell.  E. तप्त, and कुम्भ a jar.
तप्तकृच्छ्र: तप्तकृच्छ्र n. (-च्छ्रं) A sort of penance, drinking hot water, milk, and ghee for three days each, and inhaling hot air for three days.  E. तप्त heated, कृच्छ्र penance.
तप्ततपस्: तप्ततपस् m. (-पाः) An ascetic.  E. तप्त, and तपस् penance.
तप्तपाषाणकुण्ड: तप्तपाषाणकुण्ड n. (-ण्डं) A hell.  E. तप्त, पाषाण a stone, and कुण्ड a well.
तप्तबालुक: तप्तबालुक m. (-कः) A hell.  E. तप्त, and बालुका sand.
तप्तरूपक: तप्तरूपक n. (-कं) Silver.  E. तप्त, and रूपक silver.
तप्त्वा: तप्त्वा ind. 	 1. Having heated. 	 2. Having performed penance.  E. तप, and क्त्वा aff.
तप्स्यत्: तप्स्यत् mfn. (-प्स्यन्-प्स्यन्ती-प्स्यत्) Practising or intending to practise aus-terities.  E. तप् to perform penance. शतृ affix, future part.
तमःप्रवेश: तमःप्रवेश m. (-शः) 	 1. Groping in the dark. 	 2. Mental indistinctness or aberration.  E. तमस्, and प्रवेश entrance.
तमःस्थित: तमःस्थित n. (-तं) A hell, one of the lowest divisions of hell.  E. तमस्, and स्थित placed.
तम: तम (इर उ) इर्तमु r. 4th cl. (ताम्यति) 	 1. To desire. 	 2. To be distressed in body or mind.  E. खेदे अक० इच्छायां सक-दिवा-प० सेट् ।
