Violently, fiercely. subst. 	 1. A shore, a bank. 	 2. Tin. 	 3. Heat. 	 4. Pungency.  E. तीव् to be large, &c. रक् aff.
तीव्रवेदना: तीव्रवेदना f. (-ना) Agony, excessive pain, the pain of damnation.  E. तीव्र exceeding, and वेदना pain.
तु: तु r. 2nd cl. (तौति or तवति) 	 1. To go or move. 	 2. To thrive or increase. 3. To injure, to hurt or kill. 	 4. To become full. According to some authorities this is merely a Sautra root. वृत्तौ, वृद्धौ अक० हिंसायां जेतरि सक० अदा० प० अनिट् ।

तु ind. A particle, implying. 	 1. Difference, (but, or.) 	 2. Disjunction, (but, again, further, other.) 	 3. Connection, (and, moreover.) 	 4. As-severation, (indeed.) 	 4. An expletive.  E. तुद्-डु ।
तुकाक्षीरी: तुकाक्षीरी f. (-री) The manna of bamboos; also तुगा and तुगाक्षीरी. वंशरोचनायाम् ।
तुगा: तुगा f. (-गा) The manna of bamboos. वंशरोचनायाम् ।
तुङ्ग: तुङ्ग mfn. (-ङ्गः-ङ्गा-ङ्गं) 	 1. High, elevated, lofty. 	 2. Chief, principal. 	 3. Passionate, hot. 	 m. (-ङ्गः) 	 1. A tree, (Rottleria tinctoria.) 	 2. A mountain. 	 3. The planet Mercury. 	 4. The superior apsis or aphe-lion of a planet. 	 5. Top, vertex, altitude. 	 6. The cocoanut tree. 	 f. (-ङ्गी) 	 1. A kind of basil, (Ocymum gratissimum.) 	 2. Turmeric. 	 3. Night. 	 f. (-ङ्गा) Bamboo manna.  E. तुजि to guard, to dwell, to hurt, &c. affix घञ् ।
तुङ्गक: तुङ्गक m. (-कः) A tree, (Rottleria tinctoria.)  E. स्वार्थे कन् added to the preceding.
तुङ्गता: तुङ्गता f. (-ता) 	 1. Loftiness. 	 2. Passionateness.  E. तल् added to तुङ्ग; also with त्व, तुङ्गत्वम्.
तुङ्गभद्र: तुङ्गभद्र m. (-द्रः) A restive elephant or one in rut. 	 f. (-द्रा) A river in the Mysore country, the Toombhadra.  E. तुङ्ग lofty, tall, &c. and भद्र auspicious.
तुङ्गशेखर: तुङ्गशेखर m. (-रः) A mountain.  E. तुङ्ग lofty, and शेखर crest or summit.
तुङ्गिन्: तुङ्गिन् mfn. (-ङ्गी-ङ्गिनी-ङ्गि) High, lofty. 	 m. (-ङ्गी) A planet at the apex of its orbit, or of its position, with regard to others considered as-trologically.  E. तुङ्ग, and इनि aff.
तुङ्गीपति: तुङ्गीपति m. (-तिः) The moon.  E. तुङ्गी night, and पति master.
तुङ्गीश: तुङ्गीश m. (-शः) 	 1. A name of SIVA. 	 2. The moon. 	 3. The son. 	 4. A name of KRISHNA.  E. तुङ्गी night or तुङ्ग a mountain, &c. and ईश lord.
तुच्छ: तुच्छ mfn. (-च्छः-च्छा-च्छं) 	 1. Void, empty. 	 2. Small, little. 	 3. Abandoned, deserted. 	 4. Low, contemptible. 	 n. (-च्छं) Chaff.  E. तुद-सम्प० क्विप् । तुदा व्यथया छ्यति छो-क ।
तुच्छधान्यक: तुच्छधान्यक n. (-कं) Straw.  E. तुच्छ, and धान्यक grain.
तुच्छद्रु: तुच्छद्रु m. (-द्रुः) The castor-oil tree.  E. तुच्छ empty, pithless, द्रु a tree; having no sap.
तुज्: तुज् m. (-तुक्) Offspring, children.  E. तुज् to guard, affix क्विप्.
तुज: तुज r. 1st cl. (तोजति) To kill or hurt. (इ) तुजि r. 1st cl. (तुञ्जति) To guard or protect. r. 1st and 10th cls. (तुञ्जति तुञ्जयति-ते) 	 1. To dwell, to abide. 	 2. To be strong or vigorous. 	 3. To give. 	 4. To hurt, to injure or kill. 	 4. To shine.  E. प्रापणे हिंसायां च भ्वा० प० सक० बले इदित् सेट् । चुरा० उभ० अक० सेट् ।
तुञ्ज: तुञ्ज mfn. (-ञ्जः-ञ्जा-ञ्जं) Noxious, mischievous. 	 m. (-ञ्जः) A Daitya, a de-mon.  E. तुजि to hurt, affix अच् । दैत्ये वज्रे च ।
तुट: तुट r. 5th cl. (तुटति) 	 1. To dispute, to quarrel, to wrangle. 	 2. To hurt or injure.  E. तुदा० कुटा० पर० अक० सेट् ।
तुटुम: तुटुम m. (-मः) A rat.  E. तुट् to injure, affix उम.
तुड: तुड (ऋ) तुडृ द्विधाकरणे (तोडति) also (इ) तुडि r. 1st cl. निष्पीडने (तुण्डते) also तुड r. 6th cl. भेदे (तुडति) 1. To tear, to break or cut, to pull to pieces, to hurt or kill.  E. भ्वा० पर० सक० इदित् सेट् । तुदा० कुटा० पर० अक० सेट् ।
तुड्ड: तुड्ड r. 1st cl. (तुड्डति) To disrespect.  E. भ्वा० पर० सक० सेट् ।
तुण: तुण r. 6th cl. (तुणति) 	 1. To curve, to bend or make crooked. 	 2. To act fraudulently.  E. तुदा० पर० सक० सेट् ।
तुणि: तुणि m. (-णिः) A timber tree: see तुन्न.  E. तूण् to shrink or wrap, affix इन्, and the radical vowel made short.
तुण्ड: तुण्ड m. (-ण्डः) The mouth, the face.  E. तुडि to tear, (food, &c.) affix अच्, and कन् being added तुण्डक.
तुण्डकेरी: तुण्डकेरी f. (-री) A cucurbitaceous plant, (Momordica monadelpha.) E. तुण्डक the mouth, ऋ to go, अण् and ङीष् affs.
तुण्डि: तुण्डि mf. (-ण्डिः-ण्डी) 	 1. The mouth, the face. 	 2. A beak. 	 3. The navel; (also तुन्दि.)  E. तुडि to break or destroy, Unadi affix इन्.
तुण्डिका: तुण्डिका f. (-का) 	 1. The naval. 	 2. A plant, commonly Telakucha.  E. कन् added to तुण्डी.
तुण्डिकेरी: तुण्डिकेरी f. (-री) The cotton plant. 	 2. A sort of gourd, (Momordica mo-nadelpha.) 	 3. A large boil or swelling on the palate.  E. तुण्डिका the mouth or beak, ऋ to go, affixes अण् and ङीष्; also with कन् added तुण्डिकेरिका f. (-का) and with इन् fem. affix तुण्डिकेरि f. (-रिः) also तुण्डकेरी and तुण्डिकेशी.
तुण्डिकेशी: तुण्डिकेशी f. (-शी) A sort of gourd, commonly Telakucha: see the preceding.
तुण्डिभ: तुण्डिभ mfn. (-भः-भा-भं) 	 1. Having a prominent or elevated naval. E. तुण्डि the navel, भ affix; also तुण्डिम, &c.
तुण्डिल: तुण्डिल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) 	 1. Having a prominent or elevated navel. 	 2. Speaking harshly or severely.  E. तुण्डि the navel, and ल affix; also तुन्दिल, &c.
तुत्थ: तुत्थ r. 10th cl. (तुत्थयति-ते) 	 1. To screen, to veil, to cover. 	 2. To spread.  E. चुरा० उभ० सक० सेट् ।

तुत्थ m. (-त्थः) Fire. 	 f. (-त्था) 	 1. Indigo. 	 2. Small cardamoms. 	 n. (-त्थं) 	 1. A collyrium extracted from the Amomum zanthorrhiza. 	 2. Blue vitriol, sulphate of copper, especially medicinally considered as an Anjan, or application to the eyes.  E. तुद् to pain, थक् Unadi aff.
तुत्थक: तुत्थक n. (-कं) Blue vitriol.  E. कन् added to तुत्थ.
तुत्थाञ्जन: तुत्थाञ्जन n. (-नं) Blue vitriol, considered as a medicinal application to the eyes.  E. तुत्थ the same, and अञ्चन a collyrium.
तुद: तुद (औ) r. 6th cl. (तुदति-ते) To pain, to wound, to vex or harass, to tease, to torture or torment, (इ) तुदि r. 1st cl. (तुन्दति) To search, to seek.  E. तुदा० उभ० सक० अनिट् ।
तुन्द: तुन्द n. (-न्दं) The belly. 	 f. (-न्दी) The navel: see तुण्डि.  E. तुद् to torment, क affix, and नुम् augment.
तुन्दकूपी: तुन्दकूपी f. (-पी) The navel.  E. तुन्द the belly, and कूप a pit, a well, dim. affix ङीष्; also with कन् added तुन्दकूपिका f. (-का).
तुन्दपरिमार्ज: तुन्दपरिमार्ज m. (-र्जः) A lazy man, a sloth, a sluggard: see the next.
तुन्दपरिमृज: तुन्दपरिमृज m. (-जः) A lazy man, a sluggard.  E. तुन्द the belly, मृज to rub, with परि prefixed, and क affix; also with the affix घञ्, तुन्द-परिमार्ज as above; passing his whole time in stroking his sides.
तुन्दवत्: तुन्दवत् mfn. (-वान् वती-वत्) Corpulent, fat.  E. तुन्द, and मतुप् aff. also from तुन्दि, तुन्दिवत् ।
तुन्दि: तुन्दि n. (-न्दि) The belly. 	 f. (-न्दिः) The navel. 	 m. (-न्दिः) One of the Gandharbas or quiristers of Swarga.  E. तुद् to vex or harass, affix इन्, and नुम् inserted.
तुन्दिक: तुन्दिक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Having a large or prominent navel, fat, corpu-lent. 	 f. (-का) The navel.  E. तुन्दी the naval. कन् affix, or तुन्द with ठन् aff.
तुन्दित: तुन्दित mfn. (तः-ता-तं) Having a large or prominent naval.  E. तुन्द with इतच् affix; also तुन्दिक, तुन्दिल, &c.
तुन्दिन्: तुन्दिन् mfn. (-न्दी-न्दिनी-न्दि) Having a large or prominent navel.  E. तुन्द with इनि affix; also तुन्दिक, &c.
तुन्न: तुन्न mfn. (-न्नः-न्ना-न्नं) 	 1. Tormented, vexed, injured. 	 2. Cut, broken, cut down, &c. 	 m. (-न्नः) Toon or Tuna, a tree of which the wood bears some resemblance to mahogany, and is used for furniture, &c. (Cedrela tunna.)  E. तुद् to vex, affix क्त ।
तुन्नवाय: तुन्नवाय m. (-यः) A taylor.  E. तुन्न cut, (cloth, &c.) and वे to sew, affix अण्.
तुन्नसेवनी: तुन्नसेवनी f. (-नी) A suture of the skull.  E. तुन्न cut, and सेवनी a suture. तुन्नं छिन्नं सीव्यते अनया सिव-करणे ल्युट् ङीष् ।
तुप: तुप r. 1st, 6th and 10th cls. (तोपति तुपति, तोपयति) (इ) तुपि r. 1st and 10th cls. (तुम्पति, तुम्पयति-ते) To injure, to hurt or kill; also तुफ, तुम्ब, तुम्प, &c.  E. भ्वा० पर० सक० सेट् । तुदा० बधे० सक० क्लेशे-मुचादि-पर-सेट् । अदने चुरा० उभ-सक-सेट् इदित् ।
तुफ: तुफ r. 1st, 6th and 10th cls. (तोफति, तुम्फति, तोफयति-ते) To hurt or kill. E. भ्वा-सक-सेट् । बधे सक-क्लेशे अक-तुदा-मुचा-पर-सेट् ।
तुब: तुब(इ)तुबि r. 1st and 10th cls. (तुम्बति तुम्बयति-ते) To kill or hurt. r. 10th cl. (तुम्बयति-ते) To disappear.  E. भ्वा-पर-सेट् इदित् । पक्षे चुरा-उभ-सक ।
तुभ: तुभ r. 1st cl. (तोभते) 4th cl. (तुभ्यति) 9th cl. (तुभ्नाति) To kill, to hurt, to injure in any manner.  E. भ्वा-आत्म-लुङि उभ-सक-सेट् । दिवा-क्य्रा च पर-सक सेट् ।
तुमुर: तुमुर mn. (-रः-रं) Mingled combat: see तुमुल.
तुमुल: तुमुल mn. (-लः-लं) 	 1. Mingled or tumultuous combat. 	 2. Uproar, clangour, tumult, tumultuous sound or noise. 	 m. (-लः) Beleric myrobalan.  E. तु a Sautra root, to kill, to injure, &c. मुलक् affix; or with the vowel long तुमूल. 	 mn. (-लः-लं) and ल being changed to र, तुमुर as above.
तुम्प: तुम्प r. 1st and 6th cls. (तुफति, तुम्पति) 	 1. To hurt or kill. 	 2. To be distressed.  E. भ्वा-सक-पर-सेट् । बधे सक-क्लेशे अक-तुदा-पर-सेट् ।
तुम्फ: तुम्फ r. 1st. cl. (तुफति, तुम्फति) To hurt or kill.  E. भ्वा-पर-सक-सेट् । बधे सक-क्लेशे अक-तुदा-पर-सेट् ।
तुम्ब: तुम्ब mf. (-म्बः-म्बा or -म्बी) A long gourd, &c. See तुम्बि. 	 f. (-म्बा) a cow disposed to be milked.  E. तुबि to destroy, (bile, &c.) affix अच्.
तुम्बक: तुम्बक m. (-कः) A long gourd. 	 n. (-कं) The gourd. कन् added to the preceding: see तुम्बि.
तुम्बि: तुम्बि f. (-म्बिः or -तुम्बी) A long gourd, (Cucurbita lagenaris.)  E. तुबि to destroy, (bile, sickness, &c.) अच् affix; fem. affix इन् or ङीष् also with कन् added तुम्बिका.
तुम्बीपुष्प: तुम्बीपुष्प n. (-ष्पं) The flower of the Cucurbita lagenaris.  E. तुम्बी, and पुष्प a flower.
तुम्बुरी: तुम्बुरी f. (-री) 	 1. Coriander. 	 2. A bitch: see तुम्बुरु.  E. शम्यां धन्याके च ।
तुम्बुरु: तुम्बुरु m. (-रुः) 	 1. One of the Gandharbas or singers of heaven. 	 2. A celestial inhabitant and attendant upon the sanctified Jaina teach-ers. 	 n. (-रु) Coriander.  E. तुबि to hurt, &c. उरन् affix; also with the pen. long तुम्बूरु.
तुर: तुर r. 3rd cl. (तुतोर्त्ति) To go quick, to hurry, to make haste; this root is restricted to the Vedas: see त्वर जुहो० पर० अक० सेट् ।
तुर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Quick, swift.  E. तुर् to make haste, क aff.
तुरग: तुरग m. (-गः) 	 1. A horse. 	 2. The mind.  E. त्वर speed, velocity, and ग what goes, व changed to उ. 	 f. (-गी) 	 1. A plant, (Physalis flexuosa:) see अश्वगन्ध. 	 2. A mare.  E. ङीष् added to तुरग तुरेण वेगेन गच्छति गम-ड ।
तुरगगन्धा: तुरगगन्धा f. (-न्धा) A plant: see the preceding.  E. तुरग a horse, and गन्ध smell, smelling like a horse; also अश्वगन्ध, &c.
तुरगब्रह्मचर्यक: तुरगब्रह्मचर्य्यक n. (-कं) Necessary celibacy, leading a life of continence, in consequence merely of being without female society.  E. तुरग a horse, and ब्रह्मचर्य्यक the practice of a religious student, one of whose duties is continence.
तुरगब्रह्मचर्य्यक: तुरगब्रह्मचर्य्यक n. (-कं) Necessary celibacy, leading a life of continence, in consequence merely of being without female society.  E. तुरग a horse, and ब्रह्मचर्य्यक the practice of a religious student, one of whose duties is continence.
तुरगिन्: तुरगिन् mfn. (-गी-गिणी-गि) Equestrian, riding, mounted or carried in a horse. 	 m. (-गी) A horse-man, cavalier, &c.  E. तुरग a horse, and इनि aff.
तुरङ्ग: तुरङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) 	 1. A horse. 	 2. The mind, considerd as the seat of feeling as well as intellect, the heart.  E. त्वर speedily, and ग what goes. 	 f. (-ङ्गी) 	 1. A plant: see तुरगी and तुरगगन्धा. 	 2. A mare.  E. ङीष् added to the preceding.
तुरङ्गक: तुरङ्गक m. (-कः) A plant, a kind of Ghosha, commonly हस्तिधोष.  E. तुरङ्ग a horse, and कन् affix analogy; coursing through the body.
तुरङ्गद्विषणी: तुरङ्गद्विषणी f. (-णी) A she buffalo.  E. तुरङ्ग, and द्विषणी disliking.
तुरङ्गप्रिय: तुरङ्गप्रिय m. (-यः) Barley.  E. तुरङ्ग, and प्रिय fond of.
तुरङ्गम: तुरङ्गम m. (-मः) A horse.  E. तुर speed, and गम् to go, with खच् and मुम् affs.
तुरङ्गयायिन्: तुरङ्गयायिन् mfn. (-यी-यिनी-यि) Going on horse-back.  E. तुरङ्ग, यायिन् who goes.
तुरङ्गवक्त्र: तुरङ्गवक्त्र m. (-क्त्रः) A Kinnara or quirister of INDRA'S heaven.  E. तुरङ्ग a horse, and वक्त्र a face.
तुरङ्गवदन: तुरङ्गवदन m. (-नः) A celestial quirister.  E. तुरङ्ग a horse, and वदन a face; these beings are described as having the bodies of men, and the heads of horse; also similar compounds, as तुरङ्गानन, तुरङ्गवक्त्र, तुरङ्गास्य, अश्ववक्त्र, &c.
तुरङ्गारि: तुरङ्गारि m. (-रिः) 	 1. A buffalo. 	 2. Oleander.  E. तुरङ्ग, and अरि foe.
तुरङ्गिन्: तुरङ्गिन् m. (-ङ्गी) 	 1. A horse-man, a rider. 	 2. A groom.  E. तुरङ्ग, and इनि aff.
तुरायण: तुरायण subst. 	 mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Attachment to any object or pur-suit. adj Attached to any object or pursuit. 	 m. (-णः) A particular sacrifice.  E. तुर speed, haste, अय् to go, affix ल्यु; speeding towards a given end or in a certain cause: see परायण.
तुरासाह: तुरासाह m. (-षाट् or षाड्) A name of INDRA.  E. तुर for त्वर haste, सह् to bear, in the causal form, and क्विप् affix, स being changed to ष in-flexion. हलादौ षत्वं । अजादौतु न षत्वम् ।
तुरि: तुरि f. (-रिः) See the next; also तुलि.  E. तुर-इन् ।
तुरी: तुरी f. (-री) 	 1. A brush or a fibrous stick used by weavers to clean and separate the threads of the woof. 	 2. A painter's brush, &c. see तुली.
तुरीय: तुरीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Fourth, a fourth. 	 m. (-यः) A fourth part, a quarter. n. (-यं) The divine being, or universal spirit. E. irr. derived from चतुर् four, with छ affix; also तूर्य्य and तुर्य्य । तुरीय-अच् । चतुर्णां पूरणः चतुर् + छ आद्यलोपश्च ।
तुरीयभाग: तुरीयभाग m. (-गः) A fourth part or share.  E. तुरीय, and भाग share.
तुरीयभाज्: तुरीयभाज् mfn. (-भाक्) A sharer of a fourth.  E. तुरीय, and भाज् who divides.
तुरीयवर्ण: तुरीयवर्ण m. (-र्णः) The Sudra or fourth tribe of the Hindus.  E. तुरीय fourth, and वर्ण tribe.
तुरीयांश: तुरीयांश m. (-शः) A fourth part, a quarter share.  E. तरीय, and अंश a share.
तुरुष्क: तुरुष्क m. (-ष्कः) 	 1. Incense. 	 2. A country, or m. plu. (-ष्काः) 1ts inhabit-ants; Turan or Turkestan, the original country of the Turks. E. तुर् to haste, (into smoke, &c.) affix उसिक्, and कन् added.
तुर्य: तुर्य्य mfn. (-र्य्यः-र्य्या-र्य्यं) Fourth. E. irr. derived from चतुर् four, with यत् aff.
तुर्य्य: तुर्य्य mfn. (-र्य्यः-र्य्या-र्य्यं) Fourth. E. irr. derived from चतुर् four, with यत् aff.
तुर्व: तुर्व(ई)तुर्वी r. 1st cl. (तुर्वति) To hurt, to injure, to kill.  E. भ्वा-पर-सक-सेट् ।
तुर्वसु: तुर्व्वसु m. (-सुः) One of the sons of YAYATI, king of the south and eastern portion of India, reigning over the Mlechcha tribes.
तुर्व्वसु: तुर्व्वसु m. (-सुः) One of the sons of YAYATI, king of the south and eastern portion of India, reigning over the Mlechcha tribes.
तुल: तुल r. 1st and 10th cls. (तोलति तुलति तोलयति-ते or irr. तुलयति) To weigh or measure.  E. भ्वा-पर-सक-सेट् । पक्षे-चुरा-उभ० ।
तुलयित्वा: तुलयित्वा ind. Having weighed, having counterpoised, mode equal or like, &c.  E. तुल् to weigh, क्त्वा. aff.
तुलसी: तुलसी f. (-सी) A small shrub held in veneration by the Hindus, Tulasi or holy basil, (Ocymum sanctum.)  E. तुला resemblance, and षो to destroy, affixes ङ and ङीप्; being unparalleled: this plant is said to be a female metamorphosed. तुलां सादृश्यं स्यति सो-क गौरा० ङीष् ।
तुला: तुला f. (-ला) 	 1. Measure by weight. 	 2. A measure or weight of gold and silver, 100 Palas, or about 145 ounces troy. 	 3. Any balance, es-pecially a fine balance, goldsmith's or assay scales. 	 4. The sign of the zodiac, Libra. 	 5. Resemblance, likeness, equality, similarity. 6. A vessel. 	 7. Sloping beams or timbers in the roof of a house. E. तुल् to weigh or to resemble, affix अङ्.
तुलाकोटि: तुलाकोटि f. (-टिः-टी) 	 1. An ornament of the feet or toes. 	 2. A certain weight. 	 3. A hundred millions.  E. तुला a balance, कुट् to measure, affixes अङ् and इन् or ङीप्; what is valued by weight, &c. or तुला a measure, &c. and कोटि Crore, or million. तुलया तुलां वा कोटयति कुट परितापे इन् वा ङीप् ।
तुलाकोश: तुलाकोश m. (-शः) A sort of ordeal, in which the accused is tried by being weighed repeatedly in a scale: if he is lighter the second time he is pronounced innocent; if equipoised still, or heavier, he is guilty.  E. तुला a scale, and कोश ordeal.
तुलाधट: तुलाधट m. (-टः) 	 1. An oar, a paddle. 	 2. The scale or cup of a balance. E. तुला, and धट a scale. तुलायै तोलनाय धटः ।
तुलाधर: तुलाधर m. (-रः) The sun.  E. तुला the sign, and धर who has or possesses. तुलाया मानदण्डस्य धरः धृ-अच् ।
तुलाधार: तुलाधार mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) A trader, a dealer, trafficking, trading. 	 m. (-रः) 1. The sign Libra. 	 2. The string of a balance. 	 3. The beam.  E. तुला the scales, &c. आधार what or who supports.
तुलापरीक्षा: तुलापरीक्षा f. (-क्षा) Ordeal by the balance, the weight of the accused being first taken, certain prayers and ceremonies are performed, after which he is weighed again: if lighter, he is innocent, if heavy, or as at first, guilty.  E. तुला, and परीक्षा test.
तुलापुरुष: तुलापुरुष m. (-षः) A person weighed in a balance, or an effigy of him used as a weight.  E. तुला, and पुरुष a man.
तुलापुरुषदान: तुलापुरुषदान n. (-नं) Gift of gold or valuables of the weight of the donor. E. तुलापुरुष, and दान gift.
तुलाप्रग्रह: तुलाप्रग्रह m. (-हः) The string of a balance.  E. तुला, and प्रग्रह holding; also तुलाप्रग्राह ।
तुलामान: तुलामान n. (-नं) Measure by weight.  E. तुला, and मान measure.
तुलावीज: तुलावीज n. (-जं) The Gunja or berry of the Abrus precatorius, from which the goldsmith's or jeweller's weight in India is taken; the berry weighs about 1(5/16) grain troy, the factitious weight about 2(3/16).  E. तुला weight, and वीज seed.
तुलासूत्र: तुलासूत्र n. (-त्रं) The string of a balance.  E. तुला, and सूत्र thread.
तुलि: तुलि f. (-लिः or -ली) 	 1. A fibrous stick or brush used by weavers for cleaning the threads of the woof. 	 2. A painter's brush, or fibrous stick used for that purpose: see तूलिका,  E. तुल् to resemble, &c. affix क, fem. affix इन् or ङीष्; also with ल changed to र, तुरि, तुरी.
तुलिका: तुलिका f. (-का) A small bird said to resemble the wagtail.
तुलित: तुलित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Made equal or like, equalled, compared. 	 2. Weighed, counterpoised.  E. तुल् to weigh, णिच् and कर्मणि क्त affs.
तुलिफला: तुलिफला f. (-ला) The Simul or silk cotton tree.  E. तुलि for तूलि cotton, and फल fruit. तुलि तुलयुक्तं फलमस्याः ।
तुल्य: तुल्य mfn. (-ल्यः-ल्या-ल्यं) Like, resembling, equal or analogous to.  E. तुला resemblance, and यत् aff.
तुल्यता: तुल्यता f. (-ता) Likeness, sameness, equality.  E. तल् added to the last; also with त्व, तुल्यत्वं.
तुल्यपान: तुल्यपान n. (-नं) Drinking together.  E. तुल्य alike, and पान drinking.
तुल्यबल: तुल्यबल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Of equal strength.  E. तुल्य, and बल strength.
तुल्यभावन: तुल्यभावन n. (-नं) Combination of like series, (in calculation.)  E. तुल्य, and भावन computing.
तुल्यरूप: तुल्यरूप mfn. (-पः-पा-पी-पं) 	 1. Like, similar, analogous. 	 2. Of like or equal form.  E. तुल्य, and रूप nature, &c.
तुल्यवृत्ति: तुल्यवृत्ति mfn. (-त्तिः-त्तिः-त्ति) Following the same or similar occupation. E. तुल्य, and वृत्ति business.
तुल्यशुद्धि: तुल्यशुद्धि f. (-द्धिः) Equal substraction, transposition, (in Arithmetic.) E. तुल्य, शुद्धि substraction.
तुल्याकृति: तुल्याकृति mfn. (-तिः-तिः-ति) Alike, of the same form.  E. तुल्य, and आकृति form.
तुवर: तुवर mfn. (-रः-री-रं) 	 1. Astringent. 	 2. Beardless. 	 mn. (-रः-रं) An astringent taste. 	 f. (-री) 	 1. A fragrant earth. 	 2. A kind of lentil, (Cytisus cajan:) see आढकी.  E. तु a Sautra root, to remove, (disease, &c.) ष्वरच् and affix ङीष्; also कन् being added, in the fem. form तुवरिका f. (-का.)
तुवरीशिम्ब: तुवरीशिम्ब m. (-म्बः) A kind of cassia.  E. तुवरी the pulse so called, and शिम्ब Cassia tora.
तुवि: तुवि f. (-विः) A long gourd: see तुम्बी ।
तुष: तुष r. 4th cl. (ञि, औ) ञिऔतुष (तुष्यति) To be satisfied or content, to be pleased or delighted.  E. दिवा-प-ऌदित् अक-सेट् ।
तुष mf. (-षः-षा) 	 1. The husk or chaff of rice, &c. 	 2. Beleric myrobalan. E. तुष् to please or be pleased, affix क.
तुषग्रह: तुषग्रह m. (-हः) Agni or fire.  E. तुष chaff, and ग्रह who seizes. तुषेण गृह्यते गृह-कर्मणि अप् ।
तुषसार: तुषसार m. (-रः) Agni or fire.  E. तुष chaff, and सार who embraces, from सृ to go, with अण् aff. तुषं सरति अनुसरति ।
तुषानल: तुषानल m. (-लः) 	 1. A conflagration of chaff, or of the husk of corn. 	 2. A capital punishment, burning; twisting dry straw, &c. round the limbs of a criminal, and setting it on fire.  E. तुष, and अनल fire.
तुषार: तुषार mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Cold, frigid, frosty. 	 m. (-रः) 	 1. Frost. 	 2. Cold. 	 3. Thin rain, mist. 	 4. Ice or snow. 	 5. The name of a country.  E. तुष् to please, Unadi affix आरन्.
तुषारकण: तुषारकण m. (-णः) 	 1. A dew drop. 	 2. An icicle. 	 3. Hoar frost.  E. तुषार, and कण a particle.
तुषारकाल: तुषारकाल m. (-लः) Winter, the cold season.  E. तुषार, and काल time.
तुषारपात: तुषारपात m. (-तः) 	 1. Thin rain, a sprinkling, a shower. 	 2. A fall of snow.  E. तुषार, and पात falling.
तुषाराद्रि: तुषाराद्रि m. (-द्रिः) The Himalaya mountain.  E. तुषार, and अद्रि a moun-tain; also similar compounds, as तुषारपर्व्वत, तुषारशैल, &c.
तुषित: तुषित m. (-तः) A Tushita, a kind of subordinate deity, one of a class of thirty-six. F. तुष् to please, इतच् aff. तारका० इतच् ।
तुषोदक: तुषोदक n. (-कं) Rice gruel.  E. तुष to satisfy, and उदक water.
तुष्ट: तुष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) Pleased, satisfied.  E. तुष् to be pleased, कर्त्तरि क्त. ।
तुष्टि: तुष्टि f. (-ष्टिः) 	 1. Pleasure, satisfaction, gratification, content. 	 2. In-difference to every thing but that possessed or obtained. 	 3. One of the Matris.  E. तुष् to please, &c. affix भावे क्तिन्.
तुष्टिकर: तुष्टिकर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Pleasing, satisfying.  E. तुष्टि, and कर what makes.
तुष्टिजनन: तुष्टिजनन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Gratifying, giving or producing satisfaction. E. तुष्टि, and जनन birth.
तुष्टिद: तुष्टिद mfn. (-दः-दा-दं) Pleasing, ‘satisfying.’  E. तुष्टि, and द what gives.
तुष्टु: तुष्टु m. (-ष्टुः) A jewel worn in the ears.  E. तुष् to please, तुक् aff.
तुष्ट्वा: तुष्ट्वा ind. Having pleased or gratified.  E. तुष्, and क्त्वा aff.
तुस: तुस r. 1st cl. (तोसति) To sound.  E. भ्वा-पर-सक-सेट् ।
तुस m. (-सः) The husk of corn or rice: see तुष.
तुस्त: तुस्त n. (-स्तं) Dust.  E. तुस् to sound, affix क्तः see तूस्त.
तुह: तुह (इर) तुहिर r. 1st cl. (तोहति) To hurt or give pain, to kill.  E. भ्वा-पर-सक-सेट् ।
तुहिन: तुहिन n. (-नं) 	 1. Frost. 	 2. Moonlight, moonshine.  E. तुह् to give pain, इनन् Unadi aff.
तुहिनशैल: तुहिनशैल m. (-लः) The Himalaya mountains.  E. तुहिन, and शैल a moun-tain; also similar compounds, as तुहिनपर्व्वत, &c.
तुहिनांशु: तुहिनांशु m. (-शुः) The moon.  E. तुहिन cold, अंशु a ray.
तुहिनांशुतैल: तुहिनांशुतैल n. (-लं) Camphor.  E. तुहिनांशु, and तैल oil.
तुहिनाद्रि: तुहिनाद्रि m. (-द्रिः) The Himalaya mountains.  E. तुहिन, and अद्रि a moun-tain; also तुहिनशैल, &c.
तूण: तूण r. 1st cl. (तूणयते) To fill, to fill up. (तूणयति) To shrink, to contract, to close as the eye-lids or wink.  E. पूरणे चुरा-आ । सङ्कोचे उभ-सक-सेट् ।
तूण mf. (-णः-णा or -णी) A quiver, &c. 	 f. (-णी) Indigo.  E. तूण् to be filled (with arrows, &c.) अच् and टाप् affixes, or कर्मणि घञ् and ङीष् । तूण्यते बाणैः ।
तूणक: तूणक n. (-कं) A measure of verse, species of the अतिशर्करी metre.
तूणिन्: तूणिन् mfn. (-णी-णिनी-णि) Having a quiver, quivered. 	 m. (-णी) The Tun tree.  E. तूण, and इनि aff.
तूणीर: तूणीर m. (-रः) A quiver.  E. तूण to be filled (with arrows), ईरण् aff.
तूनी: तूनी f. (-नी) Sharp pain in the perinœum and lower part of the abdomen.
तूर्: तूर् f. (तूः) Speed. 	 m. (तूः) A courier.  E. तुर् to make haste, क्किप् affix, and the semivowel changed to ऊ.
तूर: तूर (ई) तूरी r. 4th cl. (तूर्य्यते) To go quick, to make haste. 	 2. To kill, to hurt or injure.  E. दिवा-आत्म हिंसायां सक० वेगे अक-सेट् ।
तूर n. (-रं) Any musical instrument. 	 f. (-री) A trumpet.  E. तूर् to speed, affix क । तूर्य्यते ताड्यते मुखमारुतेन तूर-घञर्थे कर्मणि क ।
तूर्ण: तूर्ण mfn. (-र्णः-र्णा-र्णं) Quick, expeditious n. adv. (-र्णं) Quick, swift, quickly.  E. त्वर् to go swiftly, affix कर्त्तरि भावे वा क्त ।
तूर्णि: तूर्णि m. (-र्णिः) 	 1. Speed, velocity, expedition. 	 2. Dirt, excrement. 	 3. A stanza. 	 4. The mind.  E. त्वर् to make haste, Unadi affix नि.
तूर्य: तूर्य्य mfn. (-र्य्यः-र्य्या र्य्यं) Fourth: see तुर्य्य. 	 n. (-र्य्यं) Any musical instru-ment, the genus of which four species are reckoned, as wind ins-truments, stringed instruments, &c.  E. चतुर् four, यत् deriv. irr.
तूर्य्य: तूर्य्य mfn. (-र्य्यः-र्य्या र्य्यं) Fourth: see तुर्य्य. 	 n. (-र्य्यं) Any musical instru-ment, the genus of which four species are reckoned, as wind ins-truments, stringed instruments, &c.  E. चतुर् four, यत् deriv. irr.
तूर्यखण्ड: तूर्य्यखण्ड m. (-ण्डः) A musical instrument, a sort of tabor.
तूर्य्यखण्ड: तूर्य्यखण्ड m. (-ण्डः) A musical instrument, a sort of tabor.
तूल: तूल r. 1st cl. (तूलति) 	 1. To dismiss, to send forth or turn out. 	 2. To ascertain quantity or weight; some make this a root of the tenth class (तूलयते.)  E. भ्वा-पर-सक-सेट् । चु-आ-सक-सेट् ।

तूल n. (-लं) 	 1. The mulberry. (Morus Indica.) 	 2. Æther, the heaven or atmosphere. 	 mn. (-लः-लं) Cotton. 	 f. (-ला-ली) The wick of a lamp, or cotton twisted into a similar form for applying unguents, &c. 	 f. (-ली) 	 1. Indigo. 	 2. A weaver's fibrous stick or brush. 	 3. A painter's brush, &c. see तुली and तुरी; also तूलि.  E. तूल् to dismiss, to send forth, affix अच्, fem. affixes टाप् and ङीष् ।
तूलक: तूलक n. (-कं) Cotton.  E. कन् added to the preceding.
तूलकार्मुक: तूलकार्म्मुक n. (-कं) A bow which is used for cleaning cotton.  E. तूल cotton, and कार्म्मुक bow; also similar compounds, as तूलचाप, तूलधनुः, &c.
तूलकार्म्मुक: तूलकार्म्मुक n. (-कं) A bow which is used for cleaning cotton.  E. तूल cotton, and कार्म्मुक bow; also similar compounds, as तूलचाप, तूलधनुः, &c.
तूलनाली: तूलनाली f. (-ली) A thick roll of cotton, from which it is drawn out in spinning.  E. तूल cotton, नाल a tube, affixes अण् and ङीप्; also with कन् added तूलनालिका f. (-का.)
तूलपिचु: तूलपिचु m. (-चुः) Cotton.  E. तूल cotton, and पिचु the same.
तूलशर्करा: तूलशर्करा f. (-रा) A pod or seed of the plant, any seed yielding a similar substance.  E. तूल cotton, and शर्करा sand or gravel.
तूलसेवन: तूलसेवन n. (-नं) Spinning.  E. तूल cotton, सिव्-ल्युट् aff. तूलसूत्रकर्त्तने । (काट्नाकाटा) ।
तूलि: तूलि f. (-लिः) A painter's brush, or a fibrous stick used as one, and for other purposes.  E. तूल् to send forth or cut, affix इन्ः see तूल and तूली.
तूलिका: तूलिका f. (-का) A pencil, a painter's brush, or a stick with a fibrous extremity used as one. 	 2. A mattress or quilt, a bed, a down or cot-ton bed. 	 3. An ingot mould. 	 4. A rod, &c. dipped into crucibles to try if their contents are in fusion. 	 5. A wick or twist of cotton either for a lamp or for applying unguents, &c.  E. तूली as above, and कन् added.
तूलिनी: तूलिनी f. (-नी) The silk cotton tree.  E. तूल cotton, इनि and ङीष् affs.
तूवर: तूवर m. (-रः) 	 1. A bull without horns, though of an age to have them. 2. A beardless man. 	 3. A eunuch. 	 4. An astringent taste. 	 f. (-री) A fragrant earth.  E. तू to injure, वरच् affix, and the vowel option-ally long, hence also तुवर and तुवरी; with कन् added तूवरिका and तूवरीका.
तूष: तूष r. 1st cl. (तूषति) 	 1. To satisfy. 	 2. To be satisfied or happy  E. भ्वा-पर-सक-सेट् ।
तूष्णीशील: तूष्णीशील mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Silent, taciturn.  E. तूष्णीम् silent, and शील practising.

तूष्णीम्भूत: तूष्णीम्भूत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Silent.  E. तूष्णीम्, and भूत become.

तृणकुङ्कम: तृणकुङ्कम n. (-मं) A short of perfume.  E. तृण grass, कुङ्कुम saffron.
तृणकुटी: तृणकुटी f. (-टी) A hovel, a hut of grass, or straw.  E. तृण grass, and कुटी a small house.
तृणकूर्म: तृणकूर्म्म m. (-र्म्मः) A long gourd, (Cucurbita lagenaria.)  E. तृण grass, and कूर्म्म a tortoise.
तृणकूर्म्म: तृणकूर्म्म m. (-र्म्मः) A long gourd, (Cucurbita lagenaria.)  E. तृण grass, and कूर्म्म a tortoise.
तृणकेतु: तृणकेतु m. (-तुः) A bamboo.  E. तृण grass, and केतु a banner.
तृणगोधा: तृणगोधा f. (-धा) 	 1. A kind of newt. 	 2. A chameleon. 	 3. A worm.  E. तृण grass, and गोधा a lizard.
तृणग्राहिन्: तृणग्राहिन् m. (-ही) 	 1. Amber, &c. or any gem which being rubbed be-comes electrically attractive. 	 2. Sapphire.  E. तृण grass, and ग्राहिन् what seizes.
तृणजम्भ: तृणजम्भ mfn. (-म्भः-म्भा-म्भं) 	 1. Graminivorous, one whose food is grass. 	 2. Grass-toothed, having teeth of the colour of grass, &c.  E. तृण grass, and जम्भ food, or a tooth.
तृणजाति: तृणजाति m. (-तिः) The vegetable kingdom.  E. तृण, and जाति genus.
तृणता: तृणता f. (-ता) 	 1. A bow. 	 2. The aggregate properties of grass or her-bage, gramineousness.  E. तल् affix of the abstract, added to तृण; also तृणत्व n. (-त्वं.)
तृणद्रुम: तृणद्रुम m. (-मः) A palm tree, any of the various species, any of the various species, as the palmyra, cocoanut, date, &c.  E. तृण grass, and द्रुम a tree; pre-eminent amongst gramineous plants.
तृणधान्य: तृणधान्य m. (-न्यः) Grain growing wild or without cultivation.  E. तृण grass, and धान्य grain, corn.
तृणध्वज: तृणध्वज m. (-जः) A bamboo.  E. तृण grass, and ध्वज a flag or banner.
तृणपूली: तृणपूली f. (-ली) A mat, a seat made of reeds or basket-work.  E. तृण grass, पूल् to gather together, affixes अण् and ङीष् ।
तृणमणि: तृणमणि m. (-णिः) A sort of gem, apparently amber.  E. तृण grass, and मणि a gem; attracting straws, &c.
तृणमत्कुण: तृणमत्कुण m. (-णः) A bail or surety.
तृणराज: तृणराज m. (-जः) A palmyra tree, (Borassus flabelliformis.)  E. तृण grass, राजन् a sovereign, टच् affix, leaving a final vowel.
तृणविस्तर: तृणविस्तर m. (-रः) A heap of grass.  E. तृण, and विस्तर expanse.
तृणशीत: तृणशीत n. (-तं) A fragrant grass, (Adropogon serratus.)  E. तृण grass, and शीत here said to imply abundance.
तृणशून्य: तृणशून्य mfn. subst. (-न्यः-न्या-न्यं) Arabian jasmine. adj. Free from or devoid of grass. 	 n. (-न्यं) The flower of the Ketaki.  E. तृण grass, शून्य void of.
तृणषट्पद: तृणषट्पद m. (-दः) A wasp.  E. तृण grass, and षट्पद six-foot; an insect haunting meadows, &c. having six-feet.
तृणस: तृणस mfn. (-सः-सा-सं) Grassy, made, &c. with grass.  E. तृण grass, and स aff.
तृणसारा: तृणसारा f. (-रा) The plantain or banana.  E. तृण grass, and सार essence, pith.
तृणसिंह: तृणसिंह m. (-हः) An axe.  E. तृण grass, and सिंह a lion.
तृणहर्म्म्य: तृणहर्म्म्य m. (-र्म्म्यः) A hovel, a house or upper-room of grass or straw. E. तृण grass, and हर्म्म्य a mansion.
तृणाग्नि: तृणाग्नि m. (-ग्निः) 	 1. Conflagration of chaff. 	 2. Burning a criminal wrapped up in straw.  E. तृण grass, and अग्नि fire: see तुषानल.
तृणाञ्जन: तृणाञ्जन m. (-नः) A chameleon, a lizard.  E. तृण grass, and अञ्जन a lizard.
तृणेक्षु: तृणेक्षु m. (-क्षुः) A kind of long grass, (Saccharum cylindricum.)  E. तृण, and इक्षु sugar-cane.
तृणोद्भव: तृणोद्भव m. (-वः) Rice, &c. grow wild or without cultivation.  E. तृण grass, and उद्भव produced.
तृणोल्का: तृणोल्का f. (-ल्का) A firebrand made of a wisp of straw.  E. तृण grass, उल्का a firebrand.
तृणौकस्: तृणौकस् n. (-कः) A hovel, a hut, a house of straw or mats.  E. तृण grass, and ओकस् abode.
तृणौषध: तृणौषध n. (-धं) A perfume, commonly Elaba luka.  E. तृण, and औषध a drug; resembling grass in its appearance.
तृण्या: तृण्या f. (-ण्या) A heap or quantity of grass.  E. तृण grass, यत् and टाप् affs.
तृतीय: तृतीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Third. 	 f. (-या) The third lunation the third day of the fortnight.  E. त्रि three, तीय affix, रि changed to the analogous vowel ऋ.
तृतीयक: तृतीयक m. (-कः) A tertian ague.  E. कन added to the last.
तृतीयकज्वर: तृतीयकज्वर m. (-रः) Tertian ague.  E. तृतीय, and ज्वर fever.
तृतीयप्रकृति: तृतीयप्रकृति f. (-तिः) 	 1. A eunuch. 	 2. The neuter gender: see तृतीयाप्रकृति.
तृतीयाकृत: तृतीयाकृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Thrice ploughed, (a field, &c.  E. तृतीय third, आकृत made, wrought.
तृतीयाप्रकृति: तृतीयाप्रकृति f. (-तिः) 	 1. A eunuch. 	 2. The neuter gender.  E. तृतीय the third, प्रकृति nature; neither male nor female (whose or which) the compound if more regularly तृतीयप्रकृति.
तृतीयिन्: तृतीयिन् mfn. (-यी-यिनी-यि) Having a third.  E. तृतीय, and इनि aff.
तृद: तृद (औ इर्) औतृदिर् r. 1st, 7th and 10th. cls. (तृणत्ति तृन्ते तर्दति हिंसायाम्) । 1. To kill, to injure. 	 2. To disregard. 	 3. To give. 	 4. To eat. E. रुधा-उभ-सक-सेट् । भ्वा-सक-सेट् ।
तृप: तृप r. 1st cl. (तर्पति) 4th cl. (ञि, उ) ञितृपु (तृप्यति) 5th cl. (तृप्नोति) 6th cl. (तृम्पति) and 10th cl. (तर्पयति-ते) 	 1. To please, to satisfy, to content. 	 2. To be pleased or satisfied, to be content or satiate. 3. (In the 1st and 10th cls.) To light or kindle.  E. भ्वा-पर-सक-सेट् । दिवा-पर-सक-सेट् । स्वादि-पर-सक-सेट् । चुरा-उभ-तुदा-मुचादि-पर-सक-सेट् ।

तृप्त: तृप्त mfn. (-प्तः-प्ता-प्तं) Contented, satisfied.  E. तृप् to be pleased, affix क्त.
तृपात्मन्: तृपात्मन् mfn. (-त्मा-त्मा-त्म) Contented, satisfied, tranquil.  E. तृप्त, and आत्मन् self.
तृप्ति: तृप्ति f. (-प्तिः) Satisfaction, content.  E. तृप् to please, or be pleased, affix क्तिन् ।

तृफ: तृफ r. 6th cl. (तृफति) 	 1. To content, to please. 	 2. To be pleased or con-tent. 	 3. To hurt.  E. तुदा-पर-सक-सेट् ।
तृफला: तृफला f. (-ला) The three myrobalans.  E. तृ for त्रि three, फल a fruit, fem. affix टाप्; also त्रिफला.
तृफू: तृफू m. (-फूः) A serpent in general, the serpent genus.  E. तृफ् to hurt, or kill, ऊ Unadi aff.
तृम्प: तृम्प r. 6th cl. (तृपति, तृम्पति) 	 1. To content, to please. 	 2. To be pleased तुदा-पर-सक-सेट् ।
तृम्फ: तृम्फ r. 6th cl. (तृफति, तृम्फति) 	 1. To content, to please. 	 2. To be pleased or content.  E. तुदा-पर-सक-सेट् ।
तृष: तृष (ञि आ) ञितृषा r. 4th cl. (तृष्यति) 	 1. To thirst. 	 2. To thirst metaphori-cally, to desire, to long for.  E. दिवा-पर-सक-सेट् ।

तृषाभू: तृषाभू f. (-भूः) The bladder.  E. तृषा thirst, and भू being; whence thirst arises.
तृषार्त: तृषार्त्त mfn. (-र्त्तः-र्त्ती-र्त्तं) 	 1. Affected by desire. 	 2. Thirsty, a thirst.  E. तृषा, and आर्त्त pained.
तृषार्त्त: तृषार्त्त mfn. (-र्त्तः-र्त्ती-र्त्तं) 	 1. Affected by desire. 	 2. Thirsty, a thirst.  E. तृषा, and आर्त्त pained.
तृषाह: तृषाह n. (-हं) Water. 	 f. (-हा) A kind of anise: see मधुरिका.  E. तृष thirst, आङ् before, हन् to destroy or remove, affix ड.

तृष्णा: तृष्णा f. (-ष्णा) 	 1. Thirst. 	 2. Desire, wish.  E. तृष् to thirst, न Unadi aff.
तृष्णाक्षय: तृष्णाक्षय m. (-यः) Content, resignation, patience.  E. तृष्णा greediness, thirst, and क्षय destruction.
तृष्यत्: तृष्यत् mfn. (-ष्यन्-ष्यती-ष्यत्) 	 1. Thirsting, a thirst. 	 2. Desiring.  E. तृष् to thirst, and शतृ aff.
तृह: तृह (उ) तृहु r. 6th cl. (तृहति) 10th cl. (तर्हयति-ते) also तृह r. 7th cl. (तृणेड्डि) To kill, to hurt, to injure in any manner. (इ) तृहि r. 1st cl. (तृंहति) To grow or increase.  E. तुदा-पर-सक-सेट् । चुरा-उभ पक्षे रुधा-पर-सक-सेट् ।
तॄ: तॄ r. 1st cl. (तरति) 	 1. To pass over or across. 	 2. To pass or float over, to navigate. 	 3. To float or swim. 	 4. To overcome, to surpass, With अव prefixed, To descend, as from heaven. With आङ्, To cross by a boat, &c. With उत्, a To pass over or above; b To answer; c To land, to arrive at the opposite shore. With दुर्, To cross with difficulty. With निर्, To cross safely, to obtain salvation. With प्र, To excel or surpass. With वि, a To pass from; b To relin-quish, to give, to give away, to give alms. With सम् To swim over. E. भ्वा-पर-सक-सेट् ।
ते: ते ind. With or by thee.  E. ते substituted for त्वया, but not to be con-founded with the optional inflection of the 4th and 6th cases of युष्मद् thou.

तेज m. (-जः) 	 1. Sharpness, pungency. 	 2. Sharpness of a weapon. 	 3. Brilliancy. 	 4. Spirit.  E. तिज् to sharpen, affix घञ्ः see तेजस्.

तेजनक: तेजनक m. (-कः) A kind of reed, (Saccharum sara.)  E. कन् added to the preceding.
तेजपत्र: तेजपत्र n. (-त्रं) The leaf of the Laurus cassia.  E. तेज sharp, pungent, and पत्र a leaf.
तेजल: तेजल m. (-लः) The francoline partridge.  E. तिज् to sharpen, करणे कलच् । कपिञ्जलपक्षिणि ।
तेजवत्: तेजवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) 	 1. Sharp, pungent. 	 2. Sharp as a weapon. 	 3. Bright. 	 4. Spirited, energetic. 	 f. (-ती) An aromatic plant (Pothos officinalis:) see गजपिप्पली.  E. तेज sharpness, and मतुप् aff.
तेजस्: तेजस् m. (-जाः) A name of Agni or fire. 	 n. (-जः) 	 1. Splendour, light, lustre. 	 2. Dignity, consequence. 	 3. Srength, power. 	 4. Ardour, spirit, energy. 	 5. Semen virile. 	 6. Fresh butter. 	 7. Impatience, in-ability to bear or put up with. 	 8. Gold. 	 9. Bile, the bilious hu-mour. 	 10. Marrow, the brain, &c. 	 11. Fame, glory. 	 12. Sharpness, (metallic.) 	 13. तेजित: तेजित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Sharpened, whetted, polished, burnished. 	 2. Excited, invigorated, stimulated.  E. तिज् to sharpen; णिच् and क्त affs.

तेजीयस्: तेजीयस् mfn. (-यान्-यसी-यः) 	 1. Very bright, radiant, splendid. 	 2. Very powerful or vigorous.  E. तेजस्, and ईयसुन् aff.

तेजोमय: तेजोमय mfn. (-यः-यी-यं) Luminous, brilliant, consisting or made of light.  E. तेलस्, मयट् made of.
तेजोरूप: तेजोरूप n. (-पं) 	 1. The supreme spirit. 	 2. The nature of light, &c. E. तेजस् light (divine), रूप form.
